chapter_expert_explanation_en: Overcome by the memory of Nestan-Darejan's letter and the armlet still bound to his arm, Tariel faints in the cave as Avtandil and Asmat weep over him and revive him.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
აქა მხეც-ქმნილი ტარიელ ტირს, ჭირი ეათასების;
თქვა: “მე მაქვს სამხრე, რომელი კვლა წინას მკლავსა მას ების!”
იგი შეიხსნა, მოიღო, თვალვით არ დაიფასების,
და პირსა დაიდვა, დაცაბნდა, ქვე მკვდართა დაედასების.
stanzas.english_translation: Pale he sat up, he stared with his eyes like one dazed; the rose was become quite saffron and wan; a long time he neither spoke nor looked at them; he was mightily oppressed that he remained (alive) and died not.

ორგნით ჩანს ლები მჯიღისა, მართ გულსა გარდნაკარისა;

stanzas.english_translation: He said to Avt’handil: "Hearken! Though I have the mind of a madman, I will tell thee my tale and that of her who has buried me. It seems to me a joy to meet the friend thou hast not met. It surprises me that I am alive, that I survive hale.

stanzas.english_translation: "The sight of Asmat’h, in whom I trusted as in a sister, pleased me. When I had seen the letter, she gave me this armlet, I bound it on mine arm at once, I doffed from my head that strange and rare thing of some strong, black (stuff), the veil.
